title: UDP Send and Receive
prompt: POSIX. Implement `ssize_t udp_roundtrip(int ufd, const char *msg, char *out, size_t cap)` — sendto msg to the loopback address and the socket's OWN bound port (getsockname), then recvfrom into out (at most cap-1 bytes, NUL-terminated) and return the byte count, or -1 on any failure (NULL args, cap 0). Bind ufd to port 0 before calling — the tests do.

tests.name: echo to self
tests.hint: The datagram leaves and returns through the loopback: one byte, value 'x'.

tests.name: message boundary kept
tests.hint: UDP preserves message boundaries: the whole 8-byte word arrives as one datagram.

tests.name: NULL message refused
tests.hint: NULL msg is a contract violation: -1, no send.
